BetterTube is a privacy-friendly YouTube client for Android, forked from [LibreTube](https://github.com/libre-tube/LibreTube). Its audio-only mode really saves data, and the whole app has been redesigned to feel calm, modern and fast.

## Install

Download **`BetterTube-v0.3.1.apk`** below and open it on your phone. Android may ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager. BetterTube installs next to the official LibreTube app.

> [!NOTE]
> **Already on v0.2.x or v0.3.0?** This installs as an update and keeps your data.
>
> **Coming from a v0.1.x preview?** Those were a separate test app, so move over once: in the old BetterTube, Settings → Backup and restore → **Backup**; install this version; in the new BetterTube, **Restore** the backup; then uninstall the old one.

## What's new in 0.3.1

**The mini player, tidied up.**
- Swipe up on the mini player (audio or video) to pull the player back open.
- The audio mini player now opens and closes as quickly as the video one.
- Fixed: the artwork in the audio mini player stuck out above the bar.

**Downloads:** swiping sideways now moves between your main tabs; tap Video / Audio / Playlists to switch within Downloads.

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/capheproject/BetterTube#changelog).
